results.title: HS Codes for Automotive Cargo Explained - Logisoft
results.content:
The HS code for a passenger car is 8703, broken down by fuel and engine size: 8703.80 for electric vehicles, 8703.23 for petrol engines, and 8703.32 for diesel between 1,500 and 2,500 cc. Trucks and vans fall under 8704, motorcycles under 8711, trailers under 8716, and parts and accessories under 8708. These are the first six digits set by the World Customs Organization under the current 2022 Harmonized System; each importing country then extends them to 8 to 10 digits (HTS in the US, the [...] | Digits | Purpose | Example |
 --- 
| First 2 digits | HS Chapter (Product Category) | 87 - Vehicles |
| Next 2 digits | HS Heading (Sub-category) | 03 - Passenger Cars |
| Next 2 digits | HS Subheading (More specific) | 80 - Electric Vehicles |
| Additional digits | Country-specific classification | 8703.80.00.00 (U.S. HTS Code) |

Each country extends the six-digit HS code to comply with its own trade policies, tariffs, and regulations. [...] ### 2. Vehicle Weight and Axles

 Light trucks vs. heavy-duty cargo trucks fall under different 8704 subcategories.
 Trailers and semi-trailers have unique classifications under 8716.

### 3. Usage (Passenger vs. Cargo vs. Special-Purpose)

 Passenger vehicles (8703) vs. Cargo trucks (8704) vs. Fire trucks (8705).
 Agricultural tractors vs. construction vehicles have different classifications.
